name: 78204 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78204 (San Antonio) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78204 (San Antonio) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78204 (San Antonio) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
